info.title: DockSlot Logistics & Dock Scheduling API
info.description:
API documentation for multi-tenant logistics platform.

## End-to-end request tracing

Every response carries an X-Request-ID header. Send that header on the request to correlate a call with your own logs; omit it and the server generates a UUID.

The id is recorded on the structured log line of the HTTP request and its response, persisted inside the booking outbox payload, and included in every log line the background delivery worker emits. Booking endpoints therefore hand back a single id that follows a booking from the API call, through the MySQL outbox row, to the carrier webhook delivery - including each retry attempt.

bearerAuth.description: Enter your JWT Bearer token in the format: Bearer <token>

RequestIdHeader.name: X-Request-ID
RequestIdHeader.description: Correlation id for this request. Supply your own to join DockSlot logs with your application logs, or omit it and the server will generate a UUID. Values that are longer than 128 characters or contain characters outside [A-Za-z0-9._:+-] are rejected and replaced by a generated UUID. The value (supplied or generated) is echoed back on the X-Request-ID response header, written to the booking outbox payload, and logged by the background delivery worker.

RequestId.description: The correlation id for this request: the value you sent on the X-Request-ID request header, or a server-generated UUID. Present on every response, including errors. Quote it when reporting an issue so the full request trace can be retrieved.

OperatingHour.description: One row of the weekly operational schedule template. A missing row means the facility is closed that day.

dayOfWeek.description: 1 = Monday ... 7 = Sunday. The legacy value 0 is also read as Sunday.

closeTime.description: Local closing boundary in HH:mm. 24:00 or 00:00 closes at end of day; a value at or before openTime denotes an overnight window.

isOpen.description: Set to false to close the day and remove its operating hours.

get.description:
Public readiness/liveness probe for container orchestrators (Kubernetes, ECS, Docker healthcheck).

Runs a trivial query (SELECT 1) against MySQL through Prisma. Returns 200 when the database
answers and 503 when it is unreachable, errors, or exceeds HEALTH_CHECK_TIMEOUT_MS
(default 3000ms). Responses are sent with Cache-Control: no-store so proxies never cache them.

No authentication is required, and the route sits outside /api and ahead of the Redis-backed
rate limiter so authentication or Redis outages cannot affect the probe itself.

200.description: Service is up and the database answered the probe.

503.description: Service is down: the database is unreachable, the query failed, or the probe timed out.

error.description: The failure reason as reported by the database driver or the probe timeout.

get.summary: List all warehouses for the authenticated warehouse operator

patch.description: Restricted to WAREHOUSE_ADMIN. To avoid driver confusion, the name can only be updated if there are no active bookings with status 'BOOKED'.

400.description: Cannot update dock name while active BOOKED bookings exist

post.description: Blocks out a specific time range from slot generation for maintenance or repairs. Maintenance cannot be scheduled if active bookings exist on this dock for that day.

400.description: Invalid time range

409.description: Conflict: Active bookings exist on this dock for that day

get.summary: List maintenance closures for a dock

put.description: Updates warehouse name, address, or timezone. Disallowed if active bookings with status BOOKED exist.

400.description: Cannot update warehouse core details when active BOOKED bookings exist

patch.description:
Restricted to WAREHOUSE_ADMIN. Supported increments: 30, 45, 60 minutes.
Existing confirmed bookings remain completely unaffected.

400.description: Invalid slot length (must be 30, 45, or 60)

get.summary: Get the weekly operational schedule template
get.description: Returns the weekly operating hours for the warehouse using the 1 (Monday) - 7 (Sunday) convention. Restricted to WAREHOUSE_ADMIN of the owning organization.

put.summary: Update the weekly operational schedule template
put.description:
Replaces the operating hours for the supplied days. Days use the 1 (Monday) - 7 (Sunday) convention; isOpen false closes the day.

When opening is moved later, closing is moved earlier, or a day is closed, the API checks active BOOKED and ARRIVED bookings on every dock. If any booking falls inside the removed time range the update is rejected with HTTP 400 and the message:

"Cannot update starting/end time: bookings available in related time."

Restricted to WAREHOUSE_ADMIN of the owning organization.

400.description: Invalid schedule payload, or active bookings occupy the time being removed

message.example: Cannot update starting/end time: bookings available in related time.

patch.summary: Update the weekly operational schedule template (alias)
patch.description: Alias of PUT /warehouses/{warehouseId}/hours. Restricted to WAREHOUSE_ADMIN.

400.description: Invalid schedule payload, or active bookings occupy the time being removed

get.summary: Get warehouse booking and anti-hogging policy
get.description: Restricted to WAREHOUSE_ADMIN of the owning organization.

put.summary: Update warehouse booking and anti-hogging policy
put.description: Configures maximum concurrent active bookings per carrier, maximum advance reservation days, and hard-lock window hours. Restricted to WAREHOUSE_ADMIN.

maxConcurrentBookings.description: Max active uncompleted bookings a single carrier organization can hold simultaneously

maxAdvanceDays.description: Max advance days into the future carriers can reserve slots

bookingLockWindowHours.description: Hard-lock window hours before slot start preventing standard cancellations

400.description: Invalid policy configuration parameters

post.summary: Add a new dock to a warehouse

get.summary: List all docks for a warehouse
get.description: Retrieves docks for a warehouse with real-time dynamic effectiveStatus evaluation based on active dock maintenance closures and base database status.

200.description: List of docks with real-time dynamic effectiveStatus

effectiveStatus.description: Dynamically evaluated status based on active time-bounded maintenance closures.

get.description:
Computes and returns available time slots for active docks on a target date.
Correctly evaluates IANA timezone conversions, 24/7 schedules, midnight-closing and overnight shifts, confirmed bookings, past slots, and dock maintenance closures.
Each returned slot carries both UTC instants (`slotStartTime`, `slotEndTime`) and the warehouse-local wall-clock boundaries (`localStartTime`, `localEndTime`) so clients can render times in the dock's own time zone.

parameters.name: dockId
parameters.description: Filter slots by a specific dock ID

data.description: One entry per active dock (or only the requested dock when `dockId` is supplied)

400.description: Missing or invalid targetDate

post.summary: Invite a team member with auto-assigned role and organization
post.description:
Restricted strictly to CARRIER_ADMIN or WAREHOUSE_ADMIN.
- CARRIER_ADMIN invites automatically assign the DISPATCHER role in the carrier organization.
- WAREHOUSE_ADMIN invites automatically assign the DOCK_MANAGER role in the warehouse organization.
Generates a secure 32-byte hex token valid for 48 hours and dispatches an invitation email.

email.description: Email address of the team member to invite

201.description: Invitation created and email dispatched successfully

message.example: Invitation successfully created for dispatcher@swiftlogistics.com as DISPATCHER.

400.description: Invalid email format or missing email

403.description: Forbidden. Requester is not CARRIER_ADMIN or WAREHOUSE_ADMIN

409.description: User already registered with this email

get.summary: List bookings for the authenticated user's organization
get.description: Returns bookings filtered by carrier organization or warehouse operator organization.

429.description: Too many API requests (rate limit exceeded)

post.description:
Atomically reserves a dock time slot and schedules an asynchronous outbox event.
Protected against concurrent double-booking and mobile network retries via Idempotency-Key.
Restricted to users with DISPATCHER role in a CARRIER organization.
Protected by a Redis-backed per-user booking rate limiter (RATE_LIMIT_BOOKING_MAX per RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_MS).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique key to ensure idempotent booking requests across retries

201.description: Booking confirmed and outbox event created

400.description: Slot out of operating hours, past date, invalid payload, maxAdvanceDays horizon exceeded, or carrier maxConcurrentBookings policy reached

403.description: Only carrier dispatchers with verified emails can create bookings

409.description: Slot already booked or maintenance closure active (Concurrency conflict)

429.description: Too many booking requests (booking rate limit exceeded)

patch.description: Moves an existing confirmed booking to a new time slot (and optionally a new dock). Enforces warehouse booking policies. If within the 24-hour lock window, only same-day emergency rescheduling is permitted.

400.description: Invalid slot times, max advance days exceeded, or cross-date rescheduling attempted within lock window

put.description: Moves an existing confirmed booking to a new time slot (and optionally a new dock). Enforces warehouse booking policies. If within the 24-hour lock window, only same-day emergency rescheduling is permitted.

400.description: Invalid slot times, max advance days exceeded, or cross-date rescheduling attempted within lock window

patch.description: Cancels the booking, releases the time slot for other carriers, and creates an audit log. Blocked within the bookingLockWindowHours window.

400.description: Booking is already cancelled/arrived, or cancellation attempted within the lock window

get.summary: View lifecycle audit logs for a booking
get.description: Dual-sided audit trail visible to authorized roles on both sides (warehouse operator side: WAREHOUSE_ADMIN, DOCK_MANAGER; carrier side: DISPATCHER, CARRIER_ADMIN). Tracks and displays the complete lifecycle history of every booking (who created, changed, or cancelled it).

200.description: Array of lifecycle audit log entries (CREATED, UPDATED, CANCELLED) with timestamps, actor metadata (userId, name, role), and change summaries.

403.description: Forbidden. User role or organization not authorized

get.summary: View lifecycle audit logs for a booking
get.description: Dual-sided audit trail visible to both the carrier and the operating warehouse.

200.description: Array of lifecycle audit log entries (CREATED, RESCHEDULED, CANCELLED, etc.)

patch.summary: Update operational status of a booking (Yard check-in / check-out)

400.description: Invalid status transition

post.description: Creates an Organization (CARRIER or WAREHOUSE_OPERATOR) and assigns CARRIER_ADMIN or WAREHOUSE_ADMIN.

400.description: Validation error or missing required fields

429.description: Too many API requests (rate limit exceeded)

post.summary: Authenticate user and issue JWT token
post.description: Authenticates a user by email and password and issues signed JWT tokens (JWT_EXPIRES_IN, JWT_REFRESH_EXPIRES_IN). Tracks consecutive failed login attempts and locks the account for LOGIN_LOCKOUT_DURATION_MINUTES after MAX_FAILED_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS failures.

200.description: Login successful and a JWT is issued. If the account has 2FA enabled, the access token is withheld and requires2FA/tempToken are returned instead.

token.description: Access JWT (absent when requires2FA is true)

user.description: Authenticated user (absent when requires2FA is true)

requires2FA.description: True when a 6-digit TOTP code is required to complete login.

tempToken.description: Short-lived (5 minute) token to pass to POST /auth/2fa/login-verify. Returned when requires2FA is true.

401.description: Invalid credentials (with remaining attempts before lockout)

423.description: Account temporarily locked due to consecutive failed login attempts

429.description: Too many API requests (rate limit exceeded)

get.summary: Retrieve the two-factor authentication status of the current user

isSetupPending.description: True when a TOTP secret was generated but never confirmed with a valid code.

post.summary: Generate a new TOTP secret and QR code for authenticator apps
post.description: Generates a base32 TOTP secret for the authenticated user and returns a QR code data URL, the base32 secret string, and the otpauth:// provisioning URI. The secret is persisted on the user record but 2FA stays disabled until POST /auth/2fa/verify-and-enable confirms a valid code. Re-invoking this endpoint rotates the secret, invalidating any previously scanned QR code.

200.description: Secret and QR code generated successfully

message.example: TOTP 2FA secret and QR code generated successfully.

secret.description: Base32-encoded TOTP secret for manual entry

qrCode.description: PNG data URL (data:image/png;base64,...) suitable for an tag

post.summary: Confirm a 6-digit TOTP code and enable 2FA for the account
post.description: Verifies the provided code against the stored TOTP secret and sets isTwoFactorEnabled to true. A ±1 step (30 second) window is allowed for clock drift.

token.description: The 6-digit code shown in the authenticator app

message.example: Two-factor authentication has been enabled successfully.

400.description: Missing or malformed code, 2FA setup not initiated, or the code did not verify

post.description: Requires either the current account password or a valid 6-digit TOTP code as proof of possession. On success the stored TOTP secret is cleared.

password.description: Current account password (provide this or token)

token.description: Valid 6-digit TOTP code (provide this or password)

message.example: Two-factor authentication has been disabled successfully.

400.description: 2FA is not currently enabled, or neither a password nor a valid code was supplied

401.description: Unauthorized, incorrect password, or invalid two-factor authentication code

post.summary: Complete a two-step login by verifying the 6-digit TOTP code
post.description: Second step of the 2FA login flow. Supply the tempToken returned by POST /auth/login (mode A), or supply email + password together with the code (mode B). On success the final access and refresh JWTs are issued and any failed-login counters are reset.

token.description: The 6-digit code shown in the authenticator app

tempToken.description: Short-lived (5 minute) token returned by POST /auth/login when requires2FA is true

email.description: Alternative to tempToken — the account email

password.description: Alternative to tempToken — the account password

message.example: Two-factor authentication verified successfully. Logged in.

400.description: Missing or malformed code, no tempToken or credentials supplied, or 2FA is not enabled for the account

401.description: Invalid or expired temp token, invalid credentials, or invalid TOTP code

429.description: Too many API requests (rate limit exceeded)
